title: A Tale of Two Islands
summary: Florence is out of witness protection and there’s a woman found drowned at a resort on the island she’s staying at (Saint August). The investigation is split between Florence/Darlene/Dwayne in Saint August and Neville/Naomi in Saint Marie.
method: Sleeping pills were crushed and put into the victim’s bottle. She had an inkling something was wrong so put a memory card into her scrunchie and tied it to a tree. The victim was put on an inflatable raft in the swimming pool which was gradually deflated, leading to her drowning. This establishes an alibi for the group as they were at breakfast.
motive: The victim wanted to expose the killer for driving the bullying inflicted on her when she was a teenager. She was going to expose the killer on social media and destroy her career.
notes:
Florence leads the investigation as kind of a second DI on Saint August. 
There are a lot of plot holes in the witness protection subplot because how did Neville not contact Florence the entire time, despite having her number? What did Florence do on the island while under witness protection?
